reply.text:
That is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. Shin pain is a symptom, and I won't guess at what it is or whether it's something to worry about. Get it looked at before you run on it again.

Once a clinician has cleared you, I'll build your running back around whatever they tell you, and we can work out a return that suits you. Want to pick up the training side from there?
